blocks.html: The masonry veneer units shall be adhered to the mortar scratch coat with a nominal 1/2-inch (12.7 mm) thick setting bed of mortar complying with Sections 2103 and 2512.2 applied to create a full setting bed for the back of the masonry veneer units. The masonry veneer units shall be worked into the setting bed resulting in a nominal 3/8-inch (9.5 mm) setting bed after the masonry veneer units are applied.
